hooks.command: echo '🔒 Pre-commit quality gates...' && ruff check apps/ && mypy apps/api/app --strict && pytest tests/ -v --tb=short -q 2>&1 | tail -5

jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -oP '(?<=-m ").*(?=")' | head -1 | { read -r MSG; if [ -n "$MSG" ] && ! echo "$MSG" | grep -qE '^(feat|fix|test|docs|refactor|chore)\('; then echo '{"decision": "block", "reason": "Commit message must follow: type(scope): description. Types: feat, fix, test, docs, refactor, chore"}'; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true

BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ "$BRANCH" = "main" ]; then echo '{"decision": "block", "reason": "Direct push to main is not allowed. Use feature branches + PRs. Create a branch: git checkout -b feat/your-feature"}'; fi

hooks.prompt: Adversarial review of changes being pushed. Run `git diff main...HEAD` (or `git diff HEAD~1` if on main) and scan for: (1) tenant_id missing from new DB queries, (2) raw LLM calls bypassing telemetry wrapper, (3) PII in log statements (user emails, document content), (4) new endpoints missing auth/RBAC checks, (5) hardcoded secrets or credentials. Report PASS if clean, or BLOCK with specific file:line references if any issue found.

Check if documentation is stale relative to changes being pushed. Run `git diff main...HEAD --stat` and compare changed files against docs (TECHNICAL_DEEP_DIVE.md, ARCHITECTURE_DIAGRAM.md, OPERATIONS.md, README.md, data-model.md, interfaces.md). Report STALE docs that need updating, or PASS if all current.

A feature branch was just created. Read STATUS.md to find the task matching this branch name. Run the full research protocol: read REQUIREMENTS.md for acceptance criteria, find existing patterns in the codebase, check data model impact, identify risks against project invariants (tenant isolation, telemetry, PII, citations). Return a structured research brief.

A destructive database command is about to run. Per project policy, ALL database changes (DELETE, ALTER, DROP, INSERT, UPDATE against remote DBs, alembic migrations) require explicit user approval BEFORE execution. If this is a destructive DB operation, BLOCK it. If it's not DB-related (e.g. git branch -D), allow it.
An Alembic migration command is about to run. Per project policy, ALL database schema changes require explicit user approval BEFORE execution. BLOCK this and explain what it does.

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py) ruff check "$f" --quiet 2>&1 || true ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *retrieval.py|*evidence.py|*policy.py|*verification.py|*ask_service.py) echo '{"systemMessage": "⚠️ Core RAG file modified. Ensure a failing eval exists for this change (spawn eval-writer agent)."}' ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
